## Walkthrough This pull request adds governance configuration for the Image Registry component by introducing the `control-plane-approvers` group to the OWNERS file and creating a new OWNERS_ALIASES file that defines the group's membership with 15 GitHub handles. ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**OWNERS Configuration**
`OWNERS`|Added `control-plane-approvers` to both `reviewers` and `approvers` lists for the Image Registry component.| |**Ownership Aliases**
`OWNERS_ALIASES`|New configuration file defining the `control-plane-approvers` alias with 15 named approvers.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~5 minutes
🚥 Pre-merge checks | ✅ 10

Skipping docstring coverage check. | | Stable And Deterministic Test Names | ✅ Passed | The PR modifies only OWNERS and OWNERS_ALIASES configuration files, which contain no Ginkgo test definitions or test code, making this check not applicable. | | Test Structure And Quality | ✅ Passed | The custom check for test structure is not applicable to this PR. This PR exclusively modifies administrative configuration files (OWNERS and OWNERS_ALIASES) with no Ginkgo test code. | | Microshift Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | The PR only modifies OWNERS and creates OWNERS_ALIASES files; no Ginkgo e2e tests are added, so the MicroShift compatibility check does not apply. | | Single Node Openshift (Sno) Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This PR does not add any Ginkgo e2e tests. No deployment manifests, operator code, controllers, or scheduling constraints were added or modified. | | Ote Binary Stdout Contract | ✅ Passed | The OTE Binary Stdout Contract check is inapplicable to this PR as only static YAML configuration files (OWNERS and OWNERS_ALIASES) were modified, containing no executable code or stdout operations. | | Ipv6 And Disconnected Network Test Compatibility | ✅ Passed | This pull request does not add any Ginkgo e2e tests, only modifies OWNERS configuration files. The custom check for IPv4 assumptions and external connectivity in new e2e tests is not applicable. | | Title check | ✅ Passed | The title accurately describes the main change: adding the control-plane-approvers group to the OWNERS file. |
